thread:
lee: Hi all  Lee here, joining infra today. Quick access help: project id is redwood-north1-11. Need billing link to APAC account (07J8K9-APAC003), CPU quota bump in asia-north1 (want 16 vCPUs for n2-standard), KMS decrypt access for service account runner@redwood-north1-11.iam.gserviceaccount.com on key projects/redwood-north1-11/locations/asia-north1/keyRings/serve/cryptoKeys/key1, and an AWS cross-account read role arn:aws:iam::666555444333:role/RWD-Logs-Reader so CI can pull logs. Who do I tag for each? :wave:

cloud-bot: Ticket ONB-9999 created for cloud onboarding. Please include exact project id, billing account id, KMS resource name, and AWS principal ARN. Cloud-ops hours 08:00-18:00 APAC.

ada: welcome @lee! I can own KMS + quota. Quick clarifying q: do you need sustained CPUs or just burst for short evals? Also confirm PD IOPS needs. For KMS I need the full name (you posted it, good) and the service account.

lee: Thanks @ada. Mostly burst for evals, not sustained; request = 16 vCPUs (n2-standard), PD IOPS standard. SA = runner@redwood-north1-11.iam.gserviceaccount.com.

ada: Got it. Plan: 1) open GCP quota request for asia-north1 (16 vCPUs), 2) bind roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter to runner SA for key1, 3) wait for billing to be linked before I can run the billing attach command. Example audit commands I'll run for records:

```
# link billing (run after billing confirms)
gcloud beta billing projects link redwood-north1-11 --billing-account=07J8K9-APAC003

# add KMS IAM binding
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding key1 --location=asia-north1 --keyring=serve --member='serviceAccount:runner@redwood-north1-11.iam.gserviceaccount.com' --role='roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter'
```

Note: quota requests typically 1-3 business days for vCPUs; PD IOPS may be longer.

omar: Hi @lee, billing here. We have APAC billing account 07J8K9-APAC003 (RWD-APAC-North). Reply here with "link apac-north" and confirm if you want billing export enabled and dataset name.

lee: link apac-north. Please enable export to billing_apac_north_dev. Also I added the AWS role ARN to ONB-9999.

trevor: For AWS cross-account: add the CI principal ARN that will assume the role to ONB-9999 and I'll configure the trust. Once configured CI can assume with:

```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::666555444333:role/RWD-Logs-Reader --role-session-name ci-logs --duration-seconds 3600
```

We usually require an external-id and will post it to the ticket. No separate ticket needed.

security: quick heads-up  org policy denies external IPs in asia-north1 for prod projects. If your workload needs outbound access to third-party registries, request a NAT exception or use private egress. Add justification to ONB-9999 so security can approve ASAP.

ada: Filed quota request and queued KMS binding. I'll run the KMS IAM once billing link is confirmed.

omar: Billing link complete and export enabled to billing_apac_north_dev. You should see export table populate within ~15 minutes.

cloud-bot: ONB-9999 updated: billing linked, KMS binding queued, GCP quota request submitted. Assignees: ada (cloud-ops), trevor (aws). Expected next update in ~8 hours.

lee: Amazing, thanks everyone. I'll add the CI principal and external-id to ONB-9999 and start smoke tests once quotas are provisioned. Appreciate the fast turnaround! :tada:
